title: Synthetic Marketplace Policy - Prohibited Claims
content: Listings cannot claim guaranteed medical outcomes or absolute performance claims without substantiated evidence. Risky claims require immediate revision.

title: Synthetic Seller KPI Definitions
content: Core seller KPIs include sessions, conversion rate, average selling price, return rate, and advertising cost of sales. Sudden conversion drops should be analyzed alongside traffic quality and review changes.

title: Synthetic Returns Policy Escalation
content: If return rate rises above policy threshold for two consecutive weeks, trigger listing quality review and customer issue triage.

title: Synthetic Review Velocity Risk
content: Unusual spikes in review velocity can indicate campaign distortion or compliance risk. Investigate timing, sentiment, and source attribution before bid expansion.

title: Synthetic Pricing and Margin Guardrail
content: Promotion plans should maintain a minimum gross margin floor. High discounting without incremental demand can create cannibalization risk.

title: Synthetic Seller Action Playbook
content: When conversion drops with stable traffic, prioritize PDP clarity, image refresh, review health diagnostics, and keyword relevance checks before budget increase.

title: Synthetic Compliance Severity Model
content: Severity 1 issues are informational, Severity 2 requires remediation plan, Severity 3 blocks launch until policy owner sign-off.

title: Synthetic Forecasting Guidance
content: Post-spike forecasting should use scenario ranges: soft landing, sticky growth, and re-acceleration. Plan inventory to baseline confidence, not viral peak.

title: Synthetic Ad Efficiency Guidance
content: If ACOS rises above target with weak conversion, reallocate spend toward proven terms and reduce bids on low-intent segments.

title: Synthetic Data Sensitivity Rule
content: Do not expose raw seller identifiers, payment details, or personally identifiable data in generated responses.

title: Synthetic Policy Citation Requirement
content: All compliance-related recommendations must include policy-backed rationale and reference at least one policy source.

title: Synthetic Seller Support Tone Guide
content: Responses should be direct and action-oriented. Avoid certainty when evidence is incomplete and label assumptions clearly.
